_comment: Demo dataset for the JSON mock API. Ids are 24-char hex because several handlers and client checks validate them against /^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$/. Passwords are plain text here on purpose: the mock compares them directly, there is no bcrypt and no database.

instructors.bio: Front-end engineer, ten years building interfaces for the web.
Backend and infrastructure. Believes most problems are data-modelling problems.
